t_z66c.comment: Crop reference list. One row per crop the company pollinates, with the recommended stocking density (hives per hectare) used to size orders.

columns.k_q4xd: Crop id. Joins to the block table's crop id.
columns.c_xhk2: Recommended number of hives per hectare for this crop.

t_8xjv.comment: Customers: fruit and seed growers who lease hives for the bloom, and the cooperatives some of them belong to. Cooperatives are rows of this table too: they own no blocks, and their members point to them through the parent grower column.

columns.k_fj35: Grower id. Joins to block and contract.
columns.c_2b7q: Region of the grower's head office. Codes: 1 = Upper Basin, 2 = Lower Basin, 3 = Eastern Foothills, 4 = Western Terraces, 5 = Delta, 6 = Highlands.
columns.c_5dx4: Account status: A = active, S = suspended (payment hold, no new deliveries), X = closed (former customer).
columns.c_5q2z: Date the grower became a customer.
columns.c_wts6: Credit tier: 1 = preferred, 2 = standard, 3 = watch list (must prepay).
columns.c_9dfh: For a cooperative member, the grower id of its cooperative (a row in this same table). Empty for cooperatives and independent growers.

t_3mgb.comment: Orchard blocks (fields) owned by growers. Each block grows one crop. Contracts are written per block and season.

columns.k_fj35: Owner of the block. Joins to grower.
columns.k_q4xd: Crop grown on the block. Joins to crop.
columns.c_v34z: Grower's own name for the block. Not unique.
columns.c_9p5v: Block area in hundredths of a hectare (divide by 100 for hectares).

t_8zf7.comment: Bee yards (apiaries) where hives are kept when they are not out on a contract. Every hive has one home yard.

columns.k_ngt6: Yard id. Joins to the hive table's home yard.
columns.c_fv22: Short yard code, Y01 to Y14.
columns.c_mkm8: Region the yard is in. Codes: 1 = Upper Basin, 2 = Lower Basin, 3 = Eastern Foothills, 4 = Western Terraces, 5 = Delta, 6 = Highlands.
columns.c_623g: Maximum number of hives the yard can hold.
columns.c_758d: End date of the land lease. Empty means the company owns the yard.

t_8jk7.comment: Every hive (colony) the company has owned, in service or retired.

columns.k_hkv6: Hive id. Joins to inspection and placement.
columns.k_ngt6: Home yard of the hive. Joins to yard.
columns.c_4c3j: Date the hive was set up, as a number in YYYYDDD form: the year followed by the day of the year (2024032 is 1 February 2024). Convert with to_date(value::text, 'YYYYDDD').
columns.c_p2rg: Bee stock (breed): 1 = Carniolan, 2 = Italian, 3 = Buckfast, 4 = local mixed stock.
columns.c_2ks7: Date the hive was taken out of service. Empty means the hive is in service.
columns.c_q4p6: Why the hive was retired: 1 = dead-out (colony died), 2 = absconded (colony left), 3 = sold, 4 = combined into another colony. Empty for hives in service.

t_ckp3.comment: Employees: field inspectors, drivers, yard managers and office staff, current and former.

columns.k_7sk8: Staff id. Joins to inspection (the inspector) and placement (the driver).
columns.c_kdc3: Role: I = field inspector, D = driver, M = yard manager, O = office.
columns.c_7q9x: Leaving date. Empty for current staff.

t_945w.comment: Hive inspections. One row per inspection of one hive: colony strength, brood, mite test result and queen status. Hives are inspected about monthly from February to November, and again a few days before every delivery to a contract.

columns.k_7sk8: Who did the inspection. Joins to staff.
columns.c_5mfp: Date and time of the inspection.
columns.c_5hts: Frames of bees (colony strength) times 10: 85 means 8.5 frames covered with bees.
columns.c_dmc9: Varroa mites counted in an alcohol wash of 300 bees. Empty when no mite test was done. Mite load in percent is this count divided by 3.
columns.c_m4bv: Queen status: 0 = queenright (laying queen seen), 1 = queenless, 2 = virgin or unmated queen, 3 = drone-laying queen, 9 = not checked.

t_kk9b.comment: Pollination contracts. One row per grower, block and bloom season: the hives ordered, the price per hive, the minimum strength the grower requires, the bloom window and the contract status.

columns.k_gw37: Contract id. Joins to placement and invoice.
columns.k_8r54: Block to be pollinated. Joins to block.
columns.c_q592: Season: the calendar year of the bloom.
columns.c_tk45: Minimum hive strength grade the grower requires: A, B or C (see the grades in the glossary). A hive meets the requirement when its grade is the same or better (A is best).
columns.c_zj29: Status: 1 = quoted, 2 = signed, 3 = in field (hives delivered, not all removed), 4 = closed (completed), 5 = cancelled.
columns.c_gq7j: Expected first day of bloom. Hives should be in place by this date.
columns.c_n8jr: Date the grower signed. Empty for quotes.

t_p47h.comment: Hive placements: one row per hive delivered to a contract, with the delivery and removal dates, the hive's strength grade at delivery and the driver who delivered it.

columns.k_gw37: Contract the hive was delivered for. Joins to contract.
columns.c_2qbr: Removal date. Empty while the hive is still in the field.
columns.c_3knh: Strength grade of the hive at delivery, from its pre-delivery inspection: A, B, C or R (reject).
columns.k_7sk8: Driver who delivered the hive. Joins to staff.

t_r77r.comment: Invoices and credit notes raised against contracts: a deposit at signing, a final invoice after the hives are removed, and credit notes for refunds.

columns.c_9q3t: D = deposit (25% of the contract value, at signing), F = final invoice (after removal, for the hives actually delivered less the deposit), C = credit note (a refund, with a negative amount).
columns.c_rdk7: Amount before discount, in cents. Negative for credit notes.
columns.c_7w32: Date the invoice was paid in full; for a credit note, the date the refund was applied. Empty when not yet paid.
columns.c_j45j: 1 = voided (issued in error and replaced by a new invoice); ignore voided invoices in every total. 0 = valid.
